icims_application_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time an application status changes in iCIMS. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.application: The whole application as iCIMS gives it.
output.id: The application's iCIMS id, for 'Get application'.
output.status_id: The status's id, such as D10100.

parameters.description: Only applications to this job, by its iCIMS id. Leave empty for every job.
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.description: Only when an application moves to this status, by its iCIMS id such as D10100 ('Get list values' shows them). Leave empty for any status.
parameters.name: status_id

icims_job_updated_trigger.description: Runs for each job added or changed in iCIMS. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.folder: The job's folder, such as Approved.
output.folder_id: The id of the job's folder.
output.id: The job's iCIMS id, for 'Get job'.
output.job: The whole job as iCIMS gives it.

parameters.description: Only jobs in this folder, such as Approved. Leave empty for every job.
parameters.name: folder

icims_new_application_trigger.description: Runs each time a candidate applies, or is added, to a job in iCIMS. Applications made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan, at most every five minutes.

output.application: The whole application as iCIMS gives it.
output.id: The application's iCIMS id, for 'Get application'.
output.status_id: The status's id, such as D10100.

parameters.description: Only applications to this job, by its iCIMS id. Leave empty for every job.
parameters.name: job_id

icims_new_job_trigger.description: Runs for each new job in iCIMS. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.folder: The job's folder, such as Approved.
output.folder_id: The id of the job's folder.
output.id: The job's iCIMS id, for 'Get job'.
output.job: The whole job as iCIMS gives it.

parameters.description: Only jobs in this folder, such as Approved. Leave empty for every job.
parameters.name: folder

icims_new_person_trigger.description: Runs for each new person in iCIMS. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.folder: The person's folder, such as Cand:Unreviewed.
output.folder_id: The id of the person's folder.
output.id: The person's iCIMS id, for 'Get person'.
output.person: The whole profile as iCIMS gives it.

parameters.description: Only people in this folder. Leave empty for everyone.
parameters.name: folder

icims_person_updated_trigger.description: Runs for each person added or changed in iCIMS. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.folder: The person's folder, such as Cand:Unreviewed.
output.folder_id: The id of the person's folder.
output.id: The person's iCIMS id, for 'Get person'.
output.person: The whole profile as iCIMS gives it.

parameters.description: Only people in this folder. Leave empty for everyone.
